If you’re looking for beautiful views from the top of the escarpment, countless spots to take great photos and are an all-round nature lover looking for an excellent place to hike (especially with a friend), Mount Nemo is for you.

The trails are well marked with the level of difficulty smoothly transitioning from novice (easy) to intermediate (moderate) paths and back again. Expect some very minor slopes and declivity through mostly bedrock on firm earth. However, a caution for those hiking in the fall; watch your step as many tree roots are hidden by thick layers of leaves, making the potential of an ankle injury very high.

Suggestion: Start the hike in a clockwise direction. This way you will enjoy all the beautiful views, experience the more challenging parts of the trail earlier on and finish on smooth, level and easy terrain. Keep note, the second half of the loop (heading back) and depending on weather, you will experience a slightly higher volume of mud on the trial.

Overall, a great (quite) place to hike anytime of the year whether on your own or with a friend.
